en: The Sūtra on the Dhāraṇī of the Golden Body Spoken by the Buddha,
translated by the Tripitaka Master Śīlagupta (Shi Hu), Imperially Appointed Grand Officer of the Court for the Reception of Petitions,
Acting Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and Great Master of the Transmission of the Dharma, recipient of the purple robe, under imperial decree.
At that time, the World-Honored One,
for the universal benefit of all sentient beings,
spoke this dhāraṇī, saying:
Namo buddhānāṃ | maitrītanayapratyudgata-pañcanāṃ | Namo amitābhāya tathāgatāya arhate ||
Samyaksaṃbuddhāya tadyathā oṃ maviri maviri midhavate midhavate amṛtodnava.

Pūtraṃ (52) sarve-r-ūṃ (53) vihāna vihāna (54) lokākṣam saparivāra (55) sarvasattvānāṃ ca svāhā.
The fifty-six Buddhas declared that this dhāraṇī possesses great merit.
If anyone can wear it upon the crown of their head,
all rākṣasas, piśācas, bhūtas, and other such spirits will [be subdued].
Within a thousand yojanas, they shall be unable to cause harm.
Furthermore, if there is anyone who recites this dhāraṇī once at that time.
There are various devaputras and their retinues who,
dwelling a thousand yojanas away, provide protection.
Furthermore, if there is anyone who recites this dhāraṇī:
All *ḍākinīs*, as well as those great and wicked tigers, wolves, insects, and beasts,
will naturally submit and be unable to cause harm. Furthermore,
if there is anyone who can give rise to a most sincere resolve, [they shall likewise be protected].
If one recites this dhāraṇī one hundred times every day,
that person will immediately achieve mastery over the añjana ointment;
by applying it to the eyes, they will be able to see the events of the three periods of time.
Furthermore, if anyone recites this dhāraṇī,
it can cause those with angry minds to give rise to feelings of reverence and affection.
Moreover, if anyone recites this dhāraṇī with a sincere heart two hundred thousand times (two lakṣas), [the following shall occur].
It can completely extinguish all afflictions. Furthermore, if there is a person who recites this dhāraṇī for a long period of time, that person will immediately attain the knowledge of past lives.
Moreover, if there is a person who, by means of this dhāraṇī...
If one consecrates pure oil and applies it to the head and the abdomen,
then whatever diseases the person may have— whether ailments of the head or the abdomen, or any other diseases caused by malignant poisons—
the illness will be dissolved and dispersed wherever the oil is applied.
Furthermore, if someone takes a single grain of black pepper and empowers it twenty-one times with this dhāraṇī,
they should carry it to the presence of a king.
Whatever one seeks or desires shall be attained according to one's wishes.
This dhāraṇī possesses great merit.
If one wishes to accomplish the aforementioned matters, [one should recite it].
This *Sūtra on the Dhāraṇī of the Golden Body* Spoken by the Buddha should be received and upheld.
